{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check how many rows have missing flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Missing flipper_length_mm: {missing_flipper} out of {len(penguins)}')

# Check which species have missing values
missing_by_species = penguins[penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]['species'].value_counts()
print('\nMissing values by species:\n', missing_by_species)"}
